visualCharacteristics.purpose: Bento grid of linked tiles with one large featured tile
visualCharacteristics.summary: Image-only linked tiles: one large tile beside a 2x2 grid of small tiles
visualCharacteristics.layout: From 900px the first tile spans the left half and two rows, the next four form a 2x2 grid beside it; extra tiles continue in rows of four. On mobile the first tile is full width and the rest form 2 columns. Labels sit below the images

contentPattern.structure: cell 1: tile image (the first row is the featured tile); cell 2 (optional): label and/or link. One link makes the whole tile clickable
contentPattern.source: 5 linked movement-type image tiles in a 1-large + 4-small bento layout

usage: Showcasing one hero category beside four related ones (5 tiles is the intended count).
reuseGuidance: Use when one tile should dominate. For an even grid use cards-image-tiles.
